opening.client: What is the core problem or opportunity you want to address with this client?
opening.discover:
Sure — let's find you the right template.

**Tell me what you have in mind. You can describe it by what it does ("something that helps clients understand their cash flow"), by a combination of topics ("strategic planning plus team engagement"), or by a name you half-remember ("something like the Working Capital one"). The more detail you give, the better I can match it.**
opening.plan:
Great — let's think through this together.

Before I point you to the right tool, I want to understand where you are and what you're trying to achieve — the best planning framework depends entirely on your situation.

**What's prompting you to think about planning ahead right now?**
opening.learn:
Great — this is one of the most valuable things you can invest in.

To make sure I point you to the right resource, I want to understand what you're looking to develop and what's driving it.

**What area are you most drawn to working on — winning clients, facilitation skills, the psychology side, positioning and messaging, or something else?**
opening.course:
Great — let's design your learning program together.

A good course starts with understanding what you want to develop and why — then we'll shape the right content, pace, and sequence around you.

**What are the skills or advisory concepts you'd like to develop?**

mentorDistinctions.helpIntro: A distinction teaches the system to recommend the templates {you} trust when a certain kind of client situation comes up. The system reads what the advisor typed and understands the {meaning} — so you just describe the situation in plain English, and it handles the rest. You don't need to guess every word an advisor might use.
mentorDistinctions.helpDomain: {label} — The advisory area this applies to (Conflict, Staff, Strategy, and so on). Pick where this situation belongs.
mentorDistinctions.helpDescription: {label} — Describe the client situation in one plain sentence: what's {actually} going on. Aim at the {cause}, not just the surface symptom — "the owners aren't aligned on where the business is heading" works far better than "they're arguing." This is the sentence the system reads the advisor's words against, so write it the way you'd explain the situation to a colleague.
mentorDistinctions.helpTriggers: {label} — A few different ways an advisor might describe this in their own words. These are just examples to point the system in the right direction — {not} exact phrases it has to find. Three to six varied examples is plenty; don't try to list every wording.
mentorDistinctions.helpTemplates: {label} — The templates you want brought forward when this situation appears. Pick the ones you'd reach for yourself.
mentorDistinctions.helpBoost: {label} — How hard to push those templates up the list when this situation is recognised. Leave it at the default for a gentle nudge; raise it when you want this situation to strongly steer the recommendation.
mentorDistinctions.heading: Advisory Distinctions — {domain}
mentorDistinctions.masterNotice: These are the master Advisory Distinctions. Every firm receives them as defaults, and each firm can then adapt or switch off its own copy. Adding or editing one here changes the default for every firm.
mentorDistinctions.emptyState: No distinctions for this domain yet. Add one to boost specific templates when advisors use particular phrases.
mentorDistinctions.fieldDescriptionMsg: Describe the client situation in a plain sentence — this is what the AI matches the advisor's words against. Capture the cause, not just the symptom.
mentorDistinctions.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. The owners aren't aligned on where the business is heading
mentorDistinctions.fieldTriggersMsg: Type a phrase and press Enter or comma to add. These are example ways an advisor might describe this — they guide the AI, which matches on meaning, not exact words, so 3–6 varied examples is plenty.
mentorDistinctions.noTemplatesMatch: No templates match — try clearing the filters.
mentorDistinctions.fieldBoostScoreMsg: How many points to add to each matched template's score (1–20). Default 5.
mentorDistinctions.deleteMessage: Remove "{description}"? It will no longer be a default for any firm.
mentorDistinctions.validateTriggers: Add at least one trigger phrase.
mentorDistinctions.validateTemplates: Select at least one template to boost.
